questions.stem: Which statement correctly describes the difference between plant and animal cell shape?

options.text: Plant cells have a fixed, usually rectangular shape; animal cells have a variable, often irregular shape
Both plant and animal cells always have a fixed rectangular shape
Animal cells are always round; plant cells are always triangular
Plant cells have a variable shape; animal cells have a fixed rectangular shape

questions.explanation: Plant cells have a fixed, usually rectangular shape because the rigid cellulose cell wall maintains their structure. Animal cells lack a cell wall and can have variable, often irregular shapes.
